args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after deploying v2.3.1 to production (error rate 18%, unhealthy in all regions: us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions. Rollback verified as rolled_out. Investigating root cause of v2.3.1 regression.

trace.final:
All done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with health checks failing and an 18% error rate. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 and v2.3.0 were both healthy).

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback was verified as `rolled_out`.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** for checkout-api documenting the unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0, and that root cause investigation is ongoing. The on-call engineer was paged.

4. **Verified recovery**: Post-rollback status shows `checkout-api` on v2.3.0 in all regions, **healthy** with error rate back to 0.2%.
